answer: Require every identity to act as a relay that ferries real network traffic. Random probes measure each identity's sustained throughput, like checking whether a pipe is ferrous or merely painted tin: only genuine bandwidth passes. Idle or fake identities carry no nectar of useful traffic and quietly lose standing, while the tide of probes keeps rising against any identity that stops serving. An attacker wanting a thousand Sybils must buy a thousand times the real bandwidth and keep it running, so the cost of fakery grows linearly with the size of the lie instead of staying near zero.
